local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "TraitDebuggerConfig.json"

local function saveSettings(data)
	local jsonString = HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
	
	if writefile then
		pcall(function() writefile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME, jsonString) end)
	end
	
	pcall(function()
		TeleportService:SetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig", jsonString)
	end)
end

local function loadSettings()
	local rawData = nil
	
	if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) then
		pcall(function() rawData = readfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) end)
	end
	
	if not rawData then
		pcall(function() rawData = TeleportService:GetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig") end)
	end
	
	if rawData then
		local success, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawData) end)
		if success and type(decoded) == "table" then
			return decoded
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local workbenchEspEnabled = true
local WORKBENCH_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
local WORKBENCH_HL_NAME = "WorkbenchESP"
local leaderboardVisible = true

local function setLeaderboardState(state)
	leaderboardVisible = state
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, leaderboardVisible)
	end)
end

local function purgeCustomLeaderboards()
	local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then return end
	local commonLeaderboardNames = {"leaderboard", "playerlist", "tabmenu", "scoreboard"}
	for _, ui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
		local lowerName = string.lower(ui.Name)
		for _, targetName in ipairs(commonLeaderboardNames) do
			if string.find(lowerName, targetName) then
				ui:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	if not leaderboardVisible then purgeCustomLeaderboards() end
end)

local function clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Highlight") and desc.Name == WORKBENCH_HL_NAME then
			desc:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function applyWorkbenchHighlight(obj)
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	if obj.Name == "Workbench" and not obj:FindFirstChild(WORKBENCH_HL_NAME) then
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = WORKBENCH_HL_NAME
		hl.Adornee = obj
		hl.FillColor = WORKBENCH_COLOR
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = obj
	end
end

local function refreshWorkbenchESP()
	clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end

Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc.Name == "Workbench" then
		task.wait(0.1)
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end)

local traitCategories = {
	{
		title = "MELEE TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "rustic",   name = "Methodical",          desc = "+15% melee damage"},
			{id = "manic",    name = "Manic",               desc = "+45% heavy swing speed"},
			{id = "boxer",    name = "Aggressive Behavior", desc = "+25% fist damage & faster shove"},
			{id = "violence", name = "Violent Tendencies",  desc = "+45% light swing speed"},
			{id = "honor",    name = "Honourable",          desc = "2x fist damage"}
		}
	},
	{
		title = "GUN TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "recoil",   name = "Professional",        desc = "Reduced sway & -65% recoil"},
			{id = "hip",      name = "Lone Wolf",           desc = "+65% hipfire speed, +50% lever/revolver ROF"},
			{id = "reliab",   name = "Reliable",            desc = "+65% reload speed"},
			{id = "paranoia", name = "Paranoid",            desc = "+50% semi-auto ROF"}
		}

			{id = "regen",    name = "Survivor",            desc = "+6 HP/min passive regen"}
		}
	},

		traits = {
			{id = "second",   name = "Relentless",          desc = "Increased stamina regen"},
			{id = "leg",      name = "Impatient",           desc = "+15% movement speed"},
			{id = "lungs",    name = "Calm",                desc = "+75 stamina"}
		}
	}
}

local savedTraits = {}
for _, cat in ipairs(traitCategories) do
	for _, traitData in ipairs(cat.traits) do
		savedTraits[traitData.id] = false
	end
end

local savedUiPosition = {XScale = 0, XOffset = 30, YScale = 0.5, YOffset = -255}
local savedUiVisible = true

local loadedConfig = loadSettings()
if loadedConfig then
	if loadedConfig.traits then
		for traitId, state in pairs(loadedConfig.traits) do
			if savedTraits[traitId] ~= nil then
				savedTraits[traitId] = state
			end
		end
	end
	if loadedConfig.workbenchEsp ~= nil then workbenchEspEnabled = loadedConfig.workbenchEsp end
	if loadedConfig.leaderboard ~= nil then leaderboardVisible = loadedConfig.leaderboard end
	if loadedConfig.uiPosition then savedUiPosition = loadedConfig.uiPosition end
	if loadedConfig.uiVisible ~= nil then savedUiVisible = loadedConfig.uiVisible end
end

local function persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
	local pos = mainFrame and mainFrame.Position or UDim2.new(savedUiPosition.XScale, savedUiPosition.XOffset, savedUiPosition.YScale, savedUiPosition.YOffset)
	local isVis = mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible or savedUiVisible

	saveSettings({
		traits = savedTraits,
		workbenchEsp = workbenchEspEnabled,
		leaderboard = leaderboardVisible,
		uiPosition = {
			XScale = pos.X.Scale,
			XOffset = pos.X.Offset,
			YScale = pos.Y.Scale,
			YOffset = pos.Y.Offset
		},
		uiVisible = isVis
	})
end

local function getPlayerCharacterModel()
	local activePlayers = Workspace:FindFirstChild("activePlayers")
	if not activePlayers then return nil end
	return activePlayers:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name)
end

local function getPerksFolder()
	local char = getPlayerCharacterModel()
	if not char then return nil end
	local perksFolder = char:FindFirstChild("perks")
	if not perksFolder then
		perksFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		perksFolder.Name = "perks"
		perksFolder.Parent = char
	end
	return perksFolder
end

local traitUI = {}
local layoutCounter = 0

local function updateUI()
	local perksFolder = getPerksFolder()
	local allTraitsActive = true

	for traitId, uiGroup in pairs(traitUI) do
		local valueName = "trait:" .. traitId
		local existsInGame = perksFolder and perksFolder:FindFirstChild(valueName)
		local isActive = savedTraits[traitId] or (existsInGame ~= nil)

		if isActive then
			uiGroup.Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 50, 38)
			uiGroup.Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 120, 75)
			uiGroup.Badge.Text = "ACTIVE"
			uiGroup.Badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
		else
			uiGroup.Card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)
			uiGroup.Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
			uiGroup.Badge.Text = "INACTIVE"
			uiGroup.Badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
			allTraitsActive = false
		end
	end

	if allTraitsActive then
		toggleAllBtn.Text = "DISABLE ALL"
		toggleAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 32, 32)
		toggleAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 120, 120)
	else
		toggleAllBtn.Text = "ENABLE ALL"
		toggleAllBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
		toggleAllBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 215)
	end
end

local function applyStateToFolder()
	local perksFolder = getPerksFolder()
	if not perksFolder then return false end

	local noneVal = perksFolder:FindFirstChild("trait:none")
	if noneVal then noneVal:Destroy() end

	for traitId, isEnabled in pairs(savedTraits) do
		local valueName = "trait:" .. traitId
		local existingVal = perksFolder:FindFirstChild(valueName)

		if isEnabled and not existingVal then
			local boolVal = Instance.new("BoolValue")
			boolVal.Name = valueName
			boolVal.Value = false
			boolVal.Parent = perksFolder
		elseif not isEnabled and existingVal then
			existingVal:Destroy()
		end
	end
	return true
end

for _, categoryData in ipairs(traitCategories) do
	layoutCounter = layoutCounter + 1

	local headerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	headerLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
	headerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	headerLabel.Text = categoryData.title

	headerLabel.TextSize = 10
	headerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	headerLabel.LayoutOrder = layoutCounter
	headerLabel.Parent = scroll

	for _, traitData in ipairs(categoryData.traits) do
		layoutCounter = layoutCounter + 1
		local traitId = traitData.id

		local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
		card.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 48)
		card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30)
		card.AutoButtonColor = false
		card.Text = ""
		card.LayoutOrder = layoutCounter
		card.Parent = scroll

		local cardCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		cardCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
		cardCorner.Parent = card

		local cardStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		cardStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 48)
		cardStroke.Thickness = 1
		cardStroke.Parent = card

		local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 20)
		nameLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6)
		nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		nameLabel.Text = traitData.name
		nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
		nameLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		nameLabel.TextSize = 13
		nameLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		nameLabel.Parent = card

		local descLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		descLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 16)
		descLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
		descLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		descLabel.Text = traitData.desc
		descLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 155)
		descLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		descLabel.TextSize = 11
		descLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		descLabel.Parent = card

		local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 0, 20)
		badge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -73, 0.5, -10)
		badge.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		badge.Text = "INACTIVE"
		badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 135)
		badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		badge.TextSize = 10
		badge.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
		badge.Parent = card

		traitUI[traitId] = {Card = card, Stroke = cardStroke, Badge = badge}

		card.Activated:Connect(function()
			savedTraits[traitId] = not savedTraits[traitId]
			applyStateToFolder()
			updateUI()
			persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
		end)
	end
end

toggleAllBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	local targetState = false
	for traitId, state in pairs(savedTraits) do
		if not state then
			targetState = true
			break
		end
	end

	for traitId in pairs(savedTraits) do
		savedTraits[traitId] = targetState
	end

	applyStateToFolder()
	updateUI()
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

wbToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	workbenchEspEnabled = not workbenchEspEnabled
	wbToggleBtn.Text = workbenchEspEnabled and "WORKBENCH ESP: ON" or "WORKBENCH ESP: OFF"
	wbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = workbenchEspEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
	refreshWorkbenchESP()
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

lbToggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
	setLeaderboardState(not leaderboardVisible)
	lbToggleBtn.Text = leaderboardVisible and "LEADERBOARD: ON" or "LEADERBOARD: OFF"
	lbToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = leaderboardVisible and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 45)
	persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
end)

local function hookPerks(perks)
	perks.ChildAdded:Connect(updateUI)
	perks.ChildRemoved:Connect(updateUI)
	applyStateToFolder()
	updateUI()
end

local function watchCharacter(char)
	if not char then return end
	local existingPerks = char:FindFirstChild("perks")
	if existingPerks then
		hookPerks(existingPerks)
	end
	char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "perks" then
			hookPerks(child)
		end
	end)
	applyStateToFolder()
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local applied = applyStateToFolder()
		updateUI()
		if applied then break end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
end)

local function setupWatcher()
	local activePlayers = Workspace:WaitForChild("activePlayers", 15)
	if not activePlayers then return end

	activePlayers.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == LocalPlayer.Name then
			watchCharacter(child)
		end
	end)

	local existingChar = activePlayers:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name)
	if existingChar then
		watchCharacter(existingChar)
	end
end

setupWatcher()
refreshWorkbenchESP()
setLeaderboardState(leaderboardVisible)
updateUI()

    Settings.IncomingReplicationLag = 0
end)

local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

GuiService.ErrorMessageChanged:Connect(function()
	local destinationPlaceId = 13559635034
	TeleportService:Teleport(destinationPlaceId, player)
end)

local GC = getconnections or get_signal_cons
if GC then
	for i, v in pairs(GC(player.Idled)) do
		if v.Disable then
			v.Disable(v)
		elseif v.Disconnect then
			v.Disconnect(v)
		end
	end
else
	local VirtualUser = cloneref(game:GetService("VirtualUser"))
	player.Idled:Connect(function()
		VirtualUser:CaptureController()
		VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
	end)
end

local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local backpack = player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

local wantedNames = { "Paintball Gun", "Slingshot" }
local autoEquip = true
local autoSlingshot = true
local autoPaintGun = true

local gunLastTime = 0
local gunCooldown = 0.05

local function equipAllWanted()
	for _, name in ipairs(wantedNames) do
		local tool = backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
		if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then
			tool.Parent = character
		end
	end
end

local function getAnyPart(enemy)
	return enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		or enemy:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		or enemy:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
		or enemy:FindFirstChild("Head")
		or enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
end

local function getPriorityEnemy(HRP)
	local enemiesFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
	if not enemiesFolder then
		return nil
	end

	local selectedEnemy, lowestMaxHP, nearestDist = nil, math.huge, math.huge
	for _, enemy in ipairs(enemiesFolder:GetChildren()) do
		local hum = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local part = getAnyPart(enemy)
		if hum and part and hum.Health > 0 and not enemy:FindFirstChild("BeaconShield") then
			local maxHP = hum.MaxHealth or hum.Health
			local dist = (HRP.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
			if maxHP < lowestMaxHP or (maxHP == lowestMaxHP and dist < nearestDist) then
				lowestMaxHP, nearestDist, selectedEnemy = maxHP, dist, enemy
			end
		end
	end

	return selectedEnemy
end

local function tryBoard()
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Party"):WaitForChild("RemoteEvent"):FireServer(unpack(settingparty))

	local teleportdi = { "Teleport" }
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Party"):WaitForChild("RemoteEvent"):FireServer(unpack(teleportdi))
	return true
end

local function tryLobbyWeaponSelect()
	local playerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("WeaponSelectUI") then
		local chooseweapons = {
			game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("WeaponSelectUI"),
			{
				game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("Weapons"):WaitForChild("Primaries"):WaitForChild("PaintballGun"),
				game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Assets"):WaitForChild("Weapons"):WaitForChild("Primaries"):WaitForChild("Slingshot")
			}
		}
		game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Weapons"):WaitForChild("WeaponSelection"):FireServer(unpack(chooseweapons))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function tryBaseMap()
	if Workspace:FindFirstChild("Maps")
		and Workspace.Maps:FindFirstChild("BaseMap")
		and Workspace.Maps.BaseMap:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation") then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

local function tryRankingUI()
	local playerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("RankingUI") then
		local skipranking = { "Voted" }
		local rankingRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RankingInfo")
		if rankingRemote then
			rankingRemote:FireServer(unpack(skipranking))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function tryPostGameUI()
	local playerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("PostGameUI") then
		local returnRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Functions"):FindFirstChild("ReturnToHub")
		if returnRemote then
			returnRemote:FireServer()
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
setreadonly(mt, false)
local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall
mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
	local method = getnamecallmethod()
	if method == "FireServer" then
		local remoteName = tostring(self)
		if remoteName == "PlayerDamage" or remoteName == "DamageEvent" then

	return oldNamecall(self, ...)

				slingshot.VerifyHit:FireServer(hum, part.Position, HRP.Position, part)

						HRP.Position,
						part.Position,
						part,
						{ Color = BrickColor.new(21), Quickdraw = true, ObjectBreak = true }
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end

scripts.features:
Full auto farm for Build and Kill Zombies. Open the panel, switch AUTO on, and it plays the whole loop: it drives your car down the road, rolls both machines, builds better parts into the car and spends the cash on skills.

FEATURES
- Auto drive with the game's own car physics at about 4x the car's speed (100 studs/s, a speed the server accepts)
- Drives straight through the rock piles and walls that stop cars (client side) - the record went from 2.68K to 3.23K studs and a run pays +2.2K cash instead of +1.5K
- Learns where the server corrects the speed and brakes there on the next runs
- Ends a run as soon as the car stalls - cash is paid live while driving, so nothing is lost
- Claims Loot Rain and Zeus event crates automatically
- Auto rolls both machines (rolls are free)
- Buys only parts that beat what the car already has, and holds a rare upgrade in the machine until you can afford it
- Builds better parts into the same cell of the car and mounts weapons into free weapon slots
- Auto skill tree: weapon slots, luck, golden and rainbow rolls, damage
- Auto redeem codes, quests and offline cash
- Anti-AFK: the game's own 15-minute idle rejoin is switched off

MOBILE
Works on PC and mobile - the panel asks once and scales itself, and it speaks English, German and Russian. Every setting survives a rejoin.

HOW TO RUN
1. Open Build and Kill Zombies
2. Paste the loader into your executor
3. Execute - the panel opens by itself
4. Press RightShift to show or hide it

Free and keyless. No Robux purchases are ever touched - Instant Buy, the Starter/Pro/Zeus packs and the offline tripler stay shut.

Open source, read it before you run it:
https://github.com/seltonmt012/sel01-rbx/blob/main/games/buildzombies.lua

table.insert(cors, coroutine.create(function()
	wait()
	runDummyScript(function()
		local SHOT_SPEED = 350
		local SHOT_TIME  = 20000
		local NOZZLE_OFFSET = Vector3.new(0, 0.4, -1.1)

		local PlayersService = Game:GetService('Players')
		local DebrisService  = Game:GetService('Debris')

		local Tool = script.Parent
		local Handle = Tool:WaitForChild('Handle')
		local FireSound = Handle:WaitForChild('Fire')
		local ReloadSound = Handle:WaitForChild('Reload')
		local HitFadeSound = script:WaitForChild('HitFade')
		local PointLight = Handle:WaitForChild('PointLight')

		local Character, Humanoid, Player = nil, nil, nil
		local BaseShot = nil

		local function FindCharacterAncestor(subject)
			if subject and subject ~= Workspace then
				local humanoid = subject:FindFirstChild('Humanoid')
				if humanoid then
					return subject, humanoid
				else
					return FindCharacterAncestor(subject.Parent)
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function ApplyTags(target)
			while target:FindFirstChild('creator') do
				target.creator:Destroy()
			end
			local creatorTag = Instance.new('ObjectValue')
			creatorTag.Value = Player
			creatorTag.Name = 'creator'
			local iconTag = Instance.new('StringValue')
			iconTag.Value = Tool.TextureId
			iconTag.Name = 'icon'
			iconTag.Parent = creatorTag
			creatorTag.Parent = target
			DebrisService:AddItem(creatorTag, 4)
		end

		local function GetTransparentsRecursive(instance, partsTable)
			local partsTable = partsTable or {}
			for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA('BasePart') or child:IsA('Decal') then
					table.insert(partsTable, child)
				end
				GetTransparentsRecursive(child, partsTable)
			end
			return partsTable
		end

		local function SelectionBoxify(instance)
			local selectionBox = Instance.new('SelectionBox')
			selectionBox.Adornee = instance
			selectionBox.Color = BrickColor.new('Really red')
			selectionBox.Parent = instance
			return selectionBox
		end

		local function Light(instance)
			local light = PointLight:Clone()
			light.Range = light.Range + 2
			light.Parent = instance
		end

		local function FadeOutObjects(objectsWithTransparency, fadeIncrement)
			repeat
				local lastObject = nil
				for _, object in pairs(objectsWithTransparency) do
					object.Transparency = object.Transparency + fadeIncrement
					lastObject = object
				end
				wait()
			until lastObject.Transparency >= 1 or not lastObject
		end

		local function ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)
			if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
			pcall(function() humanoid.Health = -1 end)
			pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead) end)
			pcall(function() humanoid:TakeDamage(9999999999) end)
		end

		local function PushNPC(character, direction)
			if not character or not direction then return end
			if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
			if not root then return end
			local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
			bv.Velocity = (direction.Unit * 30) + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
			bv.Parent = root
			DebrisService:AddItem(bv, 0.4)
		end

		local function WeOwnCharacter(character)
			local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character.PrimaryPart
			if not root then return false end
			local owner = nil
			pcall(function() owner = root:GetNetworkOwner() end)
			return owner == PlayersService.LocalPlayer
		end

		local function TryTakeOwnership(character)
			if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
			local gotAny = false
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					local ok = pcall(function()
						part:SetNetworkOwner(PlayersService.LocalPlayer)
					end)
					if ok then gotAny = true end
				end
			end
			for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					pcall(function() part:SetNetworkOwner(PlayersService.LocalPlayer) end)
				end
			end
			return gotAny
		end

		local function Dematerialize(character, humanoid, firstPart, pushDir)
			ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)

			PushNPC(character, pushDir)
			wait(0.15)

			pcall(function() humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0 end)

			local parts = {}
			for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA('BasePart') then
					child.Anchored = true
					table.insert(parts, child)
				elseif child:IsA('LocalScript') or child:IsA('Script') then
					child:Destroy()
				end
			end

			local selectionBoxes = {}
			local firstSelectionBox = SelectionBoxify(firstPart)
			Light(firstPart)
			wait(0.05)

			for _, part in pairs(parts) do
				if part ~= firstPart then
					table.insert(selectionBoxes, SelectionBoxify(part))
					Light(part)
				end
			end

			local objectsWithTransparency = GetTransparentsRecursive(character)
			FadeOutObjects(objectsWithTransparency, 0.1)
			wait(0.5)

			ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)
			DebrisService:AddItem(character, 2)

			local fadeIncrement = 0.05
			Delay(0.2, function()
				FadeOutObjects({firstSelectionBox}, fadeIncrement)
				if character then
					character:Destroy()
				end
			end)
			FadeOutObjects(selectionBoxes, fadeIncrement)
		end

		local function HitFlash(part)
			if not part or not part.Parent then return end
			local light = PointLight:Clone()
			light.Range = 6
			light.Brightness = 20
			light.Parent = part
			Delay(0.3, function()
				if light and light.Parent then light:Destroy() end
			end)
		end

		local function ReliableKill(character, humanoid, otherPart, pushDir)
			HitFlash(otherPart)
			local pushedOnce = false

			task.spawn(function()
				for i = 1, 60 do
					if not character.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then return end

					if WeOwnCharacter(character) then
						Dematerialize(character, humanoid, otherPart, pushDir)
						return
					end

					TryTakeOwnership(character)

					if WeOwnCharacter(character) then
						Dematerialize(character, humanoid, otherPart, pushDir)
						return
					end

					ApplyDamageStack(humanoid)

					if not pushedOnce then
						PushNPC(character, pushDir)
						pushedOnce = true
					end

					wait(0.1)
				end

				if character.Parent and humanoid.Parent and WeOwnCharacter(character) then
					Dematerialize(character, humanoid, otherPart, pushDir)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function OnTouched(shot, otherPart)
			if not shot or not shot.Parent then return end
			if shot:GetAttribute("HitNPC") then return end

			local character, humanoid = FindCharacterAncestor(otherPart)
			if not (character and humanoid) then return end
			if character == Character then return end

			if PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then return end

			shot:SetAttribute("HitNPC", true)

			local pushDir = shot.CFrame.LookVector
			local bv = shot:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyVelocity")
			if bv then pushDir = bv.Velocity end

			ApplyTags(humanoid)

			local hitFadeSound = shot:FindFirstChild(HitFadeSound.Name)
			if hitFadeSound then
				local torso = humanoid:FindFirstChild("Torso")
					or humanoid:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
					or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if torso then
					hitFadeSound.Parent = torso
					hitFadeSound:Play()
				end
			end

			shot:Destroy()

			if WeOwnCharacter(character) then
				Dematerialize(character, humanoid, otherPart, pushDir)
			else
				TryTakeOwnership(character)

				if WeOwnCharacter(character) then
					Dematerialize(character, humanoid, otherPart, pushDir)
				else
					ReliableKill(character, humanoid, otherPart, pushDir)
				end
			end
		end

		local function OnEquipped()
			Character = Tool.Parent
			Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild('Humanoid')
			Player = PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
		end

		local function OnActivated()
			if Tool.Enabled and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				Tool.Enabled = false
				FireSound:Play()

				local handleCFrame = Handle.CFrame
				local firingPoint = handleCFrame.p + handleCFrame:vectorToWorldSpace(NOZZLE_OFFSET)
				local shotCFrame = CFrame.new(firingPoint, Humanoid.TargetPoint)

				local laserShotClone = BaseShot:Clone()
				laserShotClone.CFrame = shotCFrame + (shotCFrame.lookVector * (BaseShot.Size.Z / 2))
				local bodyVelocity = Instance.new('BodyVelocity')
				bodyVelocity.velocity = shotCFrame.lookVector * SHOT_SPEED
				bodyVelocity.Parent = laserShotClone
				laserShotClone.Touched:connect(function(otherPart)
					OnTouched(laserShotClone, otherPart)
				end)
				DebrisService:AddItem(laserShotClone, SHOT_TIME)
				laserShotClone.Parent = Tool

				wait(0)
				ReloadSound:Play()
				wait(0)
				Tool.Enabled = true
			end
		end

		local function OnUnequipped() end

		BaseShot = Instance.new('Part')
		BaseShot.Name = 'Effect'
		BaseShot.FormFactor = Enum.FormFactor.Custom
		BaseShot.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 3)
		BaseShot.CanCollide = false
		BaseShot.BrickColor = BrickColor.new('Really red')
		SelectionBoxify(BaseShot)
		Light(BaseShot)
		HitFadeSound:Clone().Parent = BaseShot

		Tool.Equipped:connect(OnEquipped)
		Tool.Unequipped:connect(OnUnequipped)
		Tool.Activated:connect(OnActivated)
	end, ToolScript)
end))
